name: Selective TTS multi-agent data analysis pipeline

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: each implemented as an agent with stage-specific prompts, powered by an LLM or a vision–language model (VLM)
system_prompt_style.note: Stage prompts in mm_agents/prompts.py not included in the evidence; the prompts are conditioned on the metadata report. Templated is inferred from this.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: summarizes key metadata of the dataset (shape, schema, inferred types, small samples) and emits a concise metadata report
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: a dataset metadata report is injected up front rather than a file tree. Mismatch noted for Ambiguities.

context_compaction.note: The source files were listed but their contents were not in the bundle. The pipeline is single-shot per stage.

observation_format.evidence_quote: powered by an LLM or a vision–language model (VLM)
observation_format.note: Rendered chart images are judged and interpreted by a VLM.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: compiles executable plotting code; (iii) executes and, if needed,rectifiescode using error traces
tool_call_format.note: The model writes plotting code, which is executed. There is no tool-call API.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is visible; the code files were not included.

edit_primitive.note: Plot code is written as whole files (plot_i.py). No edit tool can be inspected.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or requirements contents were available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each round of runs proceeds through the same three core stages, data profiling, visualization, and insight generation, but withstage-local evaluators that prune weak candidates before passing results downstream.
loop_primitives.note: Branching with pruning maps to tree_search. Code rectification on error traces maps to generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.note: Directions are saved in directions.json and act as stage outputs, not as a plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: It comprises four stages, Data Profiling,Visualization, andInsight Generation andJudger Verification each implemented as an agent

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This compact contract guides downstream visualization
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: artifacts are handed from one stage to the next.

human_in_loop.note: The CLI parameter table shows no approval flag, but the code was not available.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After every stage, a dedicated LLM-based stage-local evaluator ranks candidates and discards a fixed frac-
self_verification.note: Also includes a chart quality verification call. Default judge_model is vllm.

retry_policy.note: Supplementary runs are added to reach the budget; this is not a retry after failure.

termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends after its fixed stages. The budget is counted in LLM calls, per paper Sec. 2.2.2.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Our implementation dynamically monitors the accumulated budget during execution and incrementally supplements additional runs until the target budget is reached
cost_controls.note: The budget is measured in LLM calls; max_tokens is 1500 per generation.

execution_isolation.note: Executor type is process or thread; the plot-execution boundary is not visible.

tracing.evidence_quote: insights_raw.json       # Raw insights with reasoning process
tracing.note: Per-stage JSON artifacts and a debug_budget.log are written.

eval_hooks.note: Judge scoring is built into the run.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we build an end-to-end multi-agent pipeline for generating visually insightful charts and report of given dataset
target_domain.note: Data analysis; research is the closest value.

open_source.note: No LICENSE file appears in the file tree.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Model for generator of each stage in pipeline (e.g., `gpt-4.1-nano`, `gpt-4o`, `vllm`)

first_release_date.note: Fallback to the paper v1 date; no tags or first-commit data were available.

pinned_version.evidence_quote: This is REPOSITORY EVIDENCE for the record above, at the pinned reference (protocol 4.5).
pinned_version.note: No tag; the pin is the main commit, given as a short hash.
